mentions.name: Biological cell modeling pseudo-language
mentions.description: A pseudo-language for modeling biological cells from start to finish, inspired by Erlang and adapting its ideas to biological systems; the author considers some of the modeling ideas novel.
mentions.source_excerpt:
One is to create some kind of pseudo-language that
can model biological cells, from A to Z. I am having
something similar to erlang in mind (to some extent).
